accept_reasons.AR-1088__waves_crash_on_a_shore_with_bou: aerial surf breaking over bare rock; no built structure, no vegetation, no signage. Place-free water with real weight
accept_reasons.AR-1746__a_person_typing_in_a_laptop_at_: hands and a laptop on a plain table, background thrown out; no room, no window, no text. The desk register
accept_reasons.AR-1925__waves_reaching_the_shore.mp4: sunset surf running up wet sand, framed tight to the water. Place-free
accept_reasons.AR-8987__hands_typing_on_a_laptop.mp4: hands typing on a laptop held on a lap; no face, no signage, no interior. Place-free and on-register
accept_reasons.AR-pexels_10391545__directly_above_view_: top-down over a container ship being worked, in brown river water. The framing carries no horizon and no signage, and brown water is the right water for the Patapsco
accept_reasons.AR-pexels_13596229__ship_on_horizon.mp4: open water to the horizon with a distant ship and cloud; no coast, no signage, no vegetation -- place-free, and the water/weight register the query set asks for
accept_reasons.AR-pexels_14919483__silhouette_of_a_man_: a silhouette with a torch among bare winter trees at dusk. No signage, no architecture, no face -- the night search the film's road register needs
accept_reasons.AR-pexels_15285343__an_ambulance_parked_: an American ambulance on a night suburban road: US mailbox, US wheeled bins, a US pickup, US lane marking. The attending figure is a dark silhouette, not identifiable
accept_reasons.AR-pexels_26562772__a_lighthouse_sits_on: a harbour light on a rubble mole under grey overcast. American, and the flat grey water matches this film far better than a Pacific bluff would
accept_reasons.AR-pexels_29570736__adjusting_vintage_ra: hands turning the dial of an analogue radio, macro. Place-free, and the film turns on a VHF call
accept_reasons.AR-pexels_31559304__clear_water_ripples_: clear water over pebbles, macro. Place-free water texture
accept_reasons.AR-pexels_34275089__dramatic_sunset_ligh: a banded lighthouse tower against dusk sky, framed tight enough that no shoreline enters the frame; place-free and on-register
accept_reasons.AR-pexels_34308148__sunlight_reflections: sunlight moving on a clear water surface, macro. Place-free
accept_reasons.AR-pexels_34757820__calm_ripples_and_sun: ripples over submerged rock, a different composition from 34308148 rather than a second angle on the same one
accept_reasons.AR-pexels_36192492__abstract_water_dropl: water beading and running on glass, near-monochrome macro. The named place-free exception
accept_reasons.AR-pexels_4204808__time_lapse_video_of_b: overhead cable and barbed wire against sky. No ground, no signage -- place-free, and wire is the texture ACT_3 runs on
accept_reasons.AR-pexels_5227363__raindrops_falling_on_: rain running down dark glass, macro. Place-free
accept_reasons.AR-pexels_6042260__close_up_view_of_rain: raindrops on a window with the city behind thrown so far out of focus that nothing is legible. Rain on glass
accept_reasons.AR-pexels_6595373__drone_footage_of_cont: a working US container terminal: US-spec day-cab tractors, US double-stack rail, US chassis, a city skyline behind. Nothing visibly non-American. This is the Dali's world and the only American port shot in the batch
accept_reasons.AR-pexels_7601935__cork_ships_on_the_con: a studio table-top: pin flags and small vessels on a chart. No place, no readable text, and it means the voyage the narration describes
accept_reasons.AR-pexels_9160919__close_up_of_an_analog: macro of an analogue clock face. Place-free, and 01:27:53 is the film's spine
accept_reasons.AR-pexels_9244503__person_removing_the_w: hands over a bare circuit board, macro. Place-free, and it is the electrical small-parts world the wire story needs
accept_reasons.AR-pixabay_1046__keyboard_hands_writing_: a hand on a keyboard beside an espresso, plain wood, nothing legible. Place-free desk
accept_reasons.AR-pixabay_129181__ship_sunset_sunrise_s: container ship in silhouette at sunset with a tug on the line; sea and sky only, no place tell, and it means what the narration means
accept_reasons.AR-pixabay_136284__business_office_conte: hands typing on a dark laptop, background thrown out. Place-free
accept_reasons.AR-pixabay_144820__sunset_palm_harbor_fl: a wide estuary at sunset, low dark islets on the far shore. The file names Florida but the frames carry no palm, no building and no sign -- nothing a viewer could place, and nothing non-American
accept_reasons.AR-pixabay_16224__background_sample_floo: rain on glass over a night street; a sign glows behind it but is unreadable through the water. Rain on glass
accept_reasons.AR-pixabay_197__notebook_ultrabook_typin: a wide desk with a laptop opening; no face, no room, no text. Place-free
accept_reasons.AR-pixabay_216724__bridge_river_sunset_a: a US river crossing at dusk -- steel through-truss span, US roadside marina and low-rise strip, US lane markings. A standing bridge carrying traffic, which is the film's subject before the night in question
accept_reasons.AR-pixabay_217710__puddle_raindrops_rain: rain striking a dark puddle, macro. Place-free, night, on-register
accept_reasons.AR-pixabay_234154__creek_bay_boats_dock_: aerial over a wooded tidal creek: small piers, single-family houses, a broad brown estuary. Mid-Atlantic tidewater, unmistakably American and the right water for a Patapsco film
accept_reasons.AR-pixabay_237249__ship_vessel_sea_boat_: a cargo vessel on glassy water at first light, no coast in frame. Place-free and exactly the subject
accept_reasons.AR-pixabay_274046__lighthouse_nature_sea: a lit navigation beacon on grey open water, framed tight. Place-free, and the channel is where this story starts
accept_reasons.AR-pixabay_334433__dark_ocean_ocean_wave: moonlight on open water at night. Dark -- keep the cut short -- but it has real wave structure and no place tell
accept_reasons.AR-pixabay_37697__sky_stars_lake_landsca: stars over still water with a silhouetted treeline. Night, water, nothing to place it by
accept_reasons.AR-pixabay_43559__keyboard_laptop_comput: macro of fingers across backlit keys. Place-free, and a different scale from the other desk clips
accept_reasons.AR-pixabay_46308__sunset_chain_iron_rust: a rusted chain over an out-of-focus field, macro. Place-free; steel and rust are the film's texture register
accept_reasons.AR-pixabay_46688__mouse_blue_illuminated: a hand on a mouse, held tight; no room, no window, no text. Place-free, and it belongs to the desk register already in the pool
accept_reasons.AR-pixabay_63923__street_tiles_rain_nigh: wet asphalt at night, near-abstract, strong speculars, no signage. Dark -- cut it short -- but it is the night road
accept_reasons.AR-pixabay_74388__rain_raindrops_window_: rain streaming down a window, the building behind unreadable. Rain on glass
accept_reasons.AR-v_134838__buoy_water_waves_back_and_f: a rusted red channel marker standing in moving water beside a quay wall, tight. Place-free and on-meaning; the flagged 'document_or_text' resolves to nothing readable at full frame
accept_reasons.AR-v_51457__road_rain_drops_pouring_pudd: rain falling into a puddle that reflects coloured light, abstract. Place-free night texture
